protocol.history: Current joint occupancy/LiDAR latent plus four memory frames
protocol.routes: Real directed-map lane continuations, sampled every 1/12 physical second
protocol.shared_inputs: Identical current latent, four-frame memory, checkpoint, random seed, and current LiDAR rig within each scene
protocol.changed_conditions: Future ego poses and the matching reprojected BEV layouts
protocol.layout_source: The same map and future annotated actors are reprojected into each candidate ego frame; actor world trajectories are held fixed
protocol.rendering: Each output uses its candidate ego frame, one shared camera, crop, semantic palette and LiDAR height scale
protocol.note: Counterfactual generations; no matched ground-truth future exists at the alternative ego poses
